candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DTM 2m
verified_facts: The EA 2m DTM is a bare-earth raster produced after removing surface objects and covers about 99% of England.
It merges/resamples Time Stamped and National LIDAR Programme surveys and retains the stated +/-15cm RMSE vertical-accuracy contract of the contributing surveys.
semantic_limits: A 2m spatial grid does not mean 2m vertical accuracy, and parcel use still requires exact contributing-survey lineage, date, transformation and pixel-selection evidence.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DSM 1m
verified_facts: The EA 1m DSM includes terrain plus objects such as vehicles, buildings and vegetation.
The composite is derived from merged and resampled survey archives and uses the newest best-resolution data where repeat surveys exist.
semantic_limits: A 1m DSM pixel cannot be treated as bare-earth ground height without validated surface classification or matched DTM lineage.
